en.title: Tax Deducted at Source (TDS) Explained Simply
en.directAnswer: Tax deducted at source means a payer withholds tax from a payment before giving you the balance. Depending on the current law, that deduction may count toward your final tax or have another treatment. Always keep the certificate or proof because rates and treatment differ by payment type.
